nodes.statement: Creating real harmonic angles as the crosslinks form (use_real_angles, matching the released bond/react templates) yields a positive, well- conditioned, reproducible modulus — per-seed 36.7/27.6/37.5 LJ (same sign, tight IQR). So the released model is not floppy once its angles are faithfully active; the modulus is finite and strongly density-dependent (≈79 Pa at 2.9 crosslinks/rod → ≈7 Pa at 1.0/rod).
